reviews.text: Prior appointment time agreed. Staff so friendly...

Vickie was fantastic. I was visiting from Australia with my assistance dog, Owen, and needed the short stay paperwork for his return home. Even though it was her first time completing this certificate, she was thorough, careful and kind, and everything was approved by the government vet without any issues. She even followed up afterwards to check it all went well. Highly recommend her to anyone travelling with their dog. Thank you, Vickie!

I've been attending the clinic with my dogs for many years. The whole team from reception staff, nurses and vets are so kind and caring, especially when I recently had to put one of my doggies to sleep due to old age. Its so hard to find such amazing kindness and care anywhere else.
Excellent care, friendly staff and always available when advice or help is needed. With them over ten years and trust them with making the right decisions for my dogs

We took our dog to the Ballycoolin practice on Monday after our dog became unwell very quickly,the care and attention we received was amazing from the vet to the receptionist they really went above and beyond for us,unfortunately we had to make the decision to put our beloved dog to sleep as she had deteriorated rapidly and it was the best decision for her,a massive thank you everyone at cara for your professionalism in what was a tough time for us all.
R.I.P Ruby💔
Noel Cassidy

Top class service.  Friendly staff.
They understand how much we love our pet. Dog
Great Vet, looked after our Rabbit Thumper👍 …

I can’t thank Cara Veterinary Hospital enough for the care they gave our dog. The team were kind, professional, and genuinely caring throughout. Thanks to them, he’s back to himself again, and I’m so grateful for everything they did. Highly recommend Cara Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for excellent veterinary care.

They have such a great team both here and at their Phoenix Park clinic.
Great vets, always give our dog the best care

We attended Cara vets for ten years, once a month with our first cavalier Ella, she had arthritis and Syd and his team were all just amazing with her. Eddie even came in early to work one of the mornings just to help her when she was coming to the end, I would never be able to thank him enough for doing that for our little girl. she absolutely loved going to Cara vets Ballycoolin and getting her treats of all the team up there. Amazing staff and we would never use any other vets with our Cavalier Koby that we have now. He also loves his visits to see the vets. Thank you all so much for how you look after our pets.
Emilio , thanks so much for the 5 star review, we really appreciate it!
Very nice staff. Friendly and helping with any questions you have. A bit pricy
Great experience with the care and after care of our Rabbits who went in for neutering.
Vickie went above and beyond to make sure we could get a pet passport before even seeing a single coin. Amazing costumer service.

I organised a pet passport with Caravetgroup even though I live in Wales. It was made easy by the clear instructions I received and the lovely people who work there. There are no short cuts to doing the paperwork, just follow Caravetgroup's advice and it all works. I sorted everything through Claire the practice manager who was brilliant. Don't forget to have your paperwork stamped by customs when you arrive in Dublin.

Cannot recommend Vickie highly enough when preparing your dog for the big trip overseas! Even though we were on different time zones and on the other side of the world, Vickie helped us successfully get our dog from Ireland to Australia. She is extremely knowledgeable about the whole process and you will not be put wrong by her. All the staff were very friendly whenever I phoned them and whenever my family members brought my dog in there.
Highly recommend Cara veterinary hospital , they are so professional and staff are very friendly and helpful,I won't be bringing my dog anywhere else .. thank you all
Google owner/ vet Sydney Nagle before attending here! Pet owners be warned

Thank you for being so amazing with our family when our cat Trixie recently reached the end of her life ❤️ We were blown away with how well it was dealt with. Again thanks it meant the world to my niece.

Really impressive, I chose Cara by friend’s recommendation which the previous vets not that good as my expected. Cara is professional, today Dr Eddie gave us a lot of advice and described the conditions to us extremely clearly and detailed, really appreciate and useful to us that we learned a lot on our pet’s health issues.
Avoid
My bustie was very tired i had to get him put to sleep .the professionalism was second to none .explained everything so kind .thanks so much.
Great advice and care given by the whole team. I've been using them for over ten years. Sydney is amazing!
